description: Frontend Brutalist UI redesign: completely redesign c:\stockmgmt\student-management-crud\public\index.html and c:\stockmgmt\student-management-crud\public\app.js into a modern black/yellow/off-white Brutalist dashboard with sidebar navigation, statistics cards, search/filter controls, sortable table, pagination controls, and modal for add/edit. Integrate with backend pagination, search, filtering, and sorting APIs from FEAT-001.
steps: Redesign c:\stockmgmt\student-management-crud\public\index.html structure: create dashboard layout with: (1) sidebar navigation (dark background #1A1A1A, yellow accent #FFD83D for active items, links to Dashboard/Students/Settings), (2) top header bar with page title and user info placeholder, (3) main content area with: page title section (bold oversized uppercase heading with yellow underline), statistics cards row (total students, total courses, avg age - use #111111 background, yellow borders, off-white text #F5F2EA), search/filter/add controls row, sortable student table, pagination controls at bottom, (4) modal overlay for add/edit student form. Use Tailwind utility classes for all styling. Remove old form from sidebar layout.

Apply Brutalist color palette throughout index.html: Primary Background #111111, Secondary Background #1A1A1A, Primary Accent #FFD83D (buttons, active states, borders), Primary Text #F5F2EA, Secondary Text #B8B5AC, Borders #E8E4DA, Success #34D399, Error #FF6B5E. Use bold oversized uppercase typography for headings. Strong borders (2-3px) on cards and sections. Minimal corner rounding (rounded-sm or rounded-md). Ensure responsive with Tailwind breakpoints (sm, md, lg).

Redesign student table in index.html: add sortable column headers (name, email, course, age) with click handlers and sort indicator icons (up/down arrows). Keep actions column with Edit/Delete buttons styled with yellow accent on hover. Table should have dark background with off-white text and hover states.

Add pagination controls UI in index.html: below table, create controls with: previous button (disabled when on page 1), next button (disabled when on last page), current page indicator ('Page X of Y'), records-per-page dropdown selector (options: 10, 25, 50, 100), total count display ('Showing X-Y of Z students'). Style with yellow accents for active/enabled states, muted grey for disabled.

Add search and filter controls UI in index.html: above table, create search input (placeholder 'Search by name or email...'), course filter dropdown (populated dynamically from existing courses + 'All Courses' option), age range inputs (minAge, maxAge), clear filters button, and yellow 'Add Student' button that opens modal. Group controls in a dark card with proper spacing.

Rewrite c:\stockmgmt\student-management-crud\public\app.js state management: add state object with currentPage (default 1), limit (default 10), search (default ''), courseFilter (default ''), minAge (default ''), maxAge (default ''), sortBy (default 'createdAt'), sortOrder (default 'desc'). Create resetToPageOne() helper that sets currentPage to 1 (called when search/filters change).

Rewrite loadStudents() in app.js: build query string from state (page, limit, search, course, minAge, maxAge, sortBy, order), fetch GET /api/students with query params, handle response { students, pagination }, update UI with renderStudents(students), updatePaginationUI(pagination), updateStatistics(pagination.totalStudents, students), handle loading state (show spinner), handle empty state (show 'No students found' message), handle errors.

Implement debounced search in app.js: add debounce helper (300ms delay), attach to search input oninput event, call resetToPageOne() then loadStudents() after debounce. Prevents excessive API calls while typing.

Implement filter change handlers in app.js: add event listeners for courseFilter dropdown, minAge/maxAge inputs, clear filters button. Each change calls resetToPageOne() then loadStudents(). Clear filters resets all filter state to defaults and reloads.

Implement pagination controls in app.js: add updatePaginationUI(pagination) function that updates prev/next button states (disabled class), current page display, total pages, records-per-page dropdown value, total count display. Add click handlers for prev (currentPage--), next (currentPage++), and per-page dropdown change (update limit, resetToPageOne()). Each action calls loadStudents().

Implement sortable table headers in app.js: add handleSort(column) function that toggles sortOrder (asc/desc) if same column clicked, or sets new sortBy column and defaults to asc. Update header UI with sort indicators (show up/down arrow on active column). Call loadStudents() after sort change. Attach click handlers to table headers.

Implement populateCourseFilter() in app.js: extract unique courses from all fetched students data, populate courseFilter dropdown with 'All Courses' + unique course names. Call this whenever students data loads.

Implement updateStatistics() in app.js: calculate and display total students count, total unique courses count, average age (rounded to 1 decimal). Update statistics cards in dashboard. Handle empty state (show 0 or 'N/A').

Implement modal for add/edit student in app.js: add openModal(mode, student) function that shows modal overlay, sets form title ('Add Student' or 'Edit Student'), populates form fields if editing, clears fields if adding. Add closeModal() that hides overlay and resets form. Add form submit handler that POSTs (add) or PUTs (edit) to /api/students, shows success/error messages, closes modal on success, calls loadStudents(). Keep existing client-side validation from current app.js.

Preserve all existing CRUD functionality in app.js: createStudent, updateStudent, deleteStudent logic must remain functional. Keep validateStudent() function, escapeHtml() helper, showMessage() for notifications. Ensure edit/delete buttons in table rows trigger correct handlers.

Add responsive design in both files: ensure sidebar collapses to hamburger menu on mobile (<768px), statistics cards stack vertically on small screens, table scrolls horizontally on small screens, search/filter controls stack vertically on mobile, modal is fullscreen on mobile. Use Tailwind responsive utilities (hidden md:block, flex-col md:flex-row, etc).

Test all interactive states: hover states on buttons/links (yellow highlight), focus states on inputs (yellow border), active states on navigation, disabled states on pagination buttons, loading states during API calls, empty states when no data, error states on validation/API failures. Ensure smooth transitions (transition-colors duration-200).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard layout with sidebar, header, main content area, and modal renders correctly
Brutalist color palette (black #111111, yellow #FFD83D, off-white #F5F2EA) applied consistently
Statistics cards display total students, total courses, average age correctly
Search input filters students by name or email with 300ms debounce
Course filter dropdown filters by selected course
Age range filters (minAge, maxAge) work correctly
Clear filters button resets all filters and reloads data
Table columns (name, email, course, age) are sortable with visible indicators
Pagination controls (prev, next, per-page selector) work correctly
Current page and total pages display updates correctly
Add Student button opens modal with empty form
Edit button populates modal with student data for editing
Delete button shows confirmation and deletes student
Modal form validates and submits correctly (POST for add, PUT for edit)
All CRUD operations remain functional (create, read, update, delete)
UI is responsive on desktop (1920px), tablet (768px), and mobile (375px) viewports
All interactive states (hover, focus, disabled, loading, empty, error) display correctly
Search, filters, sorting, and pagination work together correctly (e.g., search + sort + pagination)
verification: Run 'npm run dev', open http://localhost:5000 in browser
Verify dashboard layout renders with sidebar, header, statistics cards, search/filter controls, table, pagination
Verify color scheme: dark backgrounds, yellow accents, off-white text throughout
Test search: type 'john' in search input, verify students with 'john' in name/email appear after 300ms
Test course filter: select a course from dropdown, verify only students in that course appear
Test age range: enter minAge=20 maxAge=25, verify only students aged 20-25 appear
Test clear filters: click clear button, verify all filters reset and all students appear
Test sorting: click name column header, verify students sort by name ascending, click again for descending
Test pagination: navigate to page 2, verify correct students appear, verify prev/next buttons enable/disable correctly
Test per-page selector: change from 10 to 25, verify 25 students per page
Test add student: click Add Student button, fill form, submit, verify modal closes and new student appears in table
Test edit student: click Edit on a student, verify modal opens with data, change name, submit, verify update appears
Test delete student: click Delete on a student, confirm, verify student removed from table
Test responsive: resize browser to mobile width (375px), verify sidebar collapses, cards stack, table scrolls horizontally
Test combined operations: search for 'test', filter by 'CSE', sort by age descending, paginate - verify all work together
findings: Frontend Brutalist UI redesign completed successfully. Key implementations: (1) Complete dashboard layout with sidebar navigation (#1A1A1A background, yellow #FFD83D accent for active items), top header bar, and main content area. (2) Brutalist color palette applied throughout: primary bg #111111, secondary bg #1A1A1A, accent #FFD83D, primary text #F5F2EA, secondary text #B8B5AC, borders #E8E4DA, success #34D399, error #FF6B5E. (3) Statistics cards showing total students, total courses, and average age with yellow borders and dark backgrounds. (4) Search/filter controls with debounced search (300ms), course dropdown, age range inputs (minAge/maxAge), clear filters button, and prominent yellow 'Add Student' button. (5) Sortable table with column headers (name, email, course, age) with click handlers and visual sort indicators (up/down arrows), hover states on rows. (6) Pagination controls with prev/next buttons, page indicator, records-per-page dropdown (10/25/50/100), and showing range display. (7) Modal overlay for add/edit student form with dark background overlay, yellow accents, form validation, and toast notifications. (8) State management tracking currentPage, limit, search, courseFilter, minAge, maxAge, sortBy, sortOrder with resetToPageOne() helper. (9) Full API integration with FEAT-001 backend: buildQueryString() constructs proper query params, loadStudents() handles pagination response structure {students, pagination}. (10) Mobile responsive design with hamburger menu toggle for sidebar, stacked cards and controls on small screens, horizontal table scroll. (11) All interactive states implemented: hover (yellow highlight), focus (yellow border), disabled (30% opacity), loading (spinner), empty ('No Students Found'), error (red toast). (12) All existing CRUD functionality preserved: validateStudent(), escapeHtml(), edit/delete handlers, client-side validation. (13) Course filter dynamically populated from fetched student data. (14) Combined search, filtering, sorting, and pagination work together correctly. All 100 backend tests pass with 100% coverage, confirming no regressions in API functionality.
